subject.title: feat(cursor): add token cost report with Cursor-metered total

question: Should CodexBar fetch detailed Cursor usage-event history through the existing authenticated session, or require a separate explicit opt-in for this account-wide remote data source?
rationale: The code is technically reviewable, but only the repository owner can define whether existing provider and global cost settings constitute adequate consent for the broader private-endpoint data scope.

options.title: Require explicit opt-in
options.body: Add a separate user-controlled setting with approved privacy and source wording before detailed Cursor event-history requests are allowed.

options.title: Reuse existing cost consent
options.body: Declare the existing Cursor-enabled plus Show cost summary combination sufficient consent and document the account-wide private endpoint prominently.

options.title: Retain summary-only Cursor
options.body: Do not ship detailed event-history cost reporting until a stable source or different product contract is available.

recommendation.title: Require explicit opt-in
recommendation.body: Add a separate user-controlled setting with approved privacy and source wording before detailed Cursor event-history requests are allowed.

likelyOwner.reason: He owns the relevant current-main paths and explicitly placed this exact product/privacy hold.
